reason: Semantic cases; policy_check.py runs a focused black-box subset against an externally built CLI. This file itself is not an implementation test result.

cases.input: 4+ mixes with stable IDs and arbitrary user labels including spaces/Unicode; Call/Record/Monitor optional
cases.expect: accept all requested mixes, no fixed three-name/count cap or silent truncation; this test size is not a product limit

cases.input: Same mix -> two physical sinks plus a virtual consumer, with distinct output gains/mutes
cases.expect: all edges retained; output A gain/mute does not change B, other mixes or shared mix sends

cases.input: Requested endpoint/device/buffer capacity exceeds actual backend resources
cases.expect: explicit preflight failure with required/available limits; no silent dropping, partial publication or unrelated mutation

cases.input: Rename display label on an active user mix
cases.expect: mix/output stable IDs and selected consumer/device identity unchanged; no duplicate endpoint

cases.input: Mic reaches any physical output, including via a mix named Call, Archive, or a user label
cases.expect: explicit physical-output consent required independently of mix name; a rename cannot enable mic monitoring or bypass consent

cases.input: Two output edges converge on the same exact physical target UID
cases.expect: reject initially before mutation; output gain is included in each accepted target's conservative headroom calculation; never double-sum a physical target silently

cases.input: Two stable mix IDs have the same display label; rename one while a call-return exclusion is active
cases.expect: accept duplicate labels; route/exclusion/device selection remains keyed by stable IDs and groups, not labels

cases.input: Create/rename/delete a mix while unrelated held consumer endpoints and sibling output routes remain active
cases.expect: all requested endpoints accounted for; scoped lifecycle and explicitly reported held-endpoint behavior; no sibling interruption, unrelated disruption or stale owned publication

cases.input: Capacity preflight fails or native publication fails after some owned endpoints were created
cases.expect: explicit failure/degraded outcome and owned-only rollback; held existing endpoints and sibling devices continue, no partial-success pass

cases.input: Same mic into three arbitrary mixes with gains 1/.5/0; per-mix master=1
cases.expect: accept independent sends; zero-gain destination silent; starter names are not schema enums

cases.input: Change only Call mic from 1 to .25
cases.expect: Record stays .5 and Monitor stays 0

cases.input: Mute Record mic with retained gain .5
cases.expect: Record mic silence; Call gain 1 unchanged; unmute restores .5

cases.input: A user mix receives a source from its excluded logical call-return group, including through alias/recapture
cases.expect: reject before mutation; multiple destination-specific groups allowed and rename never alters exclusions

cases.input: A -> B -> A or a self-loop
cases.expect: reject before mutation

cases.input: Unselected private application is active
cases.expect: no send to any bus; no all-system playback default

cases.input: Mixyard-owned output/producer selected as application source
cases.expect: reject before mutation

cases.input: Selected exact UID absent, another mic/default present
cases.expect: disconnected/silence; never choose another mic or normalize surviving sends

cases.input: Selector matches two persistent identities
cases.expect: disconnected with diagnostic; never first-match selection

cases.input: send=-.1, NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity; master=-.1, 1.1, NaN, Infinity
cases.expect: reject every invalid value; master 0 and 1 accepted; finite send >1 allowed only when peak bound permits

cases.input: master * sum(unmuted send gains) = 1.01
cases.expect: reject; no silent normalization or unimplemented limiter

cases.input: master=.5, one unmuted send=2; or master=1 and unmuted gains=.5+.25+.25
cases.expect: accept exact conservative bound 1

cases.input: master=1, mic=1 plus muted media=1
cases.expect: accept while muted; reject unmute unless headroom changed explicitly

cases.input: mono -> stereo; stereo -> mono; 6-channel -> any unsupported mix/output layout
cases.expect: duplicate; average (L+R)/2; reject unsupported layout respectively

cases.input: apply twice, interrupt mutation, reapply, release management, teardown
cases.expect: bounded changes of owned objects only; unrelated routes unchanged; release disables repair
